help.new: /new [project] — create a session or switch project
help.sessions: /sessions [project] — view old sessions for the current project
help.resume: /resume <number> — resume a session from the list
help.paging: /sessions next / /sessions prev — page through the list
help.cancel: /cancel — leave the picker and keep the current session
help.title: Available commands:
status.none:
No active session.

Send /sessions to pick an old session, /new to start one, or /projects to choose a project.
status.title: Current session:
permission.hint: Reply 1 to allow once, 2 to always allow, 3 to deny.
chat.pairing.success:
Paired successfully. You can start chatting now.

Send a message to talk to Claude, or /help to see the available commands.
chat.pairing.unauthorized: Not authorized. Generate a pairing code in the Claude Code desktop app and send it to me.
chat.send.failed: Failed to send the message; the connection may have dropped. Send /new to start over.
chat.clear.failed: Could not send /clear. Send /new to reconnect the session first.
chat.permission.sendFailed: Failed to send the permission response; check the session state.
chat.session.rebuilding: The session context expired; rebuilding automatically...
chat.session.rebuilt: Session rebuilt. Please send your message again.
chat.session.rebuildFailed: Failed to rebuild the session. Send /new to create one manually.
chat.session.expired: The session context expired. Send /new to create a session.
chat.connect.timeout: Timed out connecting to the server. Please try again.
chat.projects.none:
No recent projects found. /new will use the default working directory: {dir}
You can also send /new /path/to/project to pick a project.
chat.session.created: Session created. You can start chatting.
chat.projects.ambiguous:
Multiple projects match. Please be more specific:

{list}
chat.projects.notFound: No project matches "{query}". Send /projects to see the full list.
session.busy.permission: The current session is running or waiting for approval. Handle the approval or send /stop, then switch once it stops.
session.unavailable: That session no longer exists, its directory is unavailable, or IM access is not allowed. Send /sessions to refresh the list.
session.checkFailed: Could not check the session; the current binding is unchanged: {error}. Please try again.
session.busy: The current session is running. Send /stop, then switch once it stops.
session.connectTimeout: Timed out connecting to the server
session.resumeFailed: Resume failed; the previous session binding was kept: {error}. Please try again.
session.canceled: Selection cancelled; the current session is unchanged.
session.resumeError: Could not resume the session: {error}. Try /sessions again.
session.pickerExpired: That selection list does not exist or has expired. Send /sessions to choose again.
session.projectNotFound: No project named “{query}”. Send /sessions projects to choose a project, or /sessions <absolute path>.
session.noHistory: No accessible project history. Send /new to create a session, or /sessions <project absolute path> to look up old sessions.
session.projectEmpty:
That project has no sessions to resume: {project}

session.invalidChoice: Invalid number. Use a number shown on the current page, or send /sessions to refresh the list.
session.chooseProject: Choose the project that holds the old session:

session.replyToResume: Reply with a number or /resume <number> to resume an old session.
session.cancelHint: /cancel to dismiss; the list is valid for 15 minutes.
session.reconnect: Cannot reach the existing session right now. The session and working directory are preserved; please try again shortly.
